{{Top|leg}}
'''Kenda''' was a [[Bakuran]] commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kenda commented on the [[disruption bubble generator]] entry, noting that nearly every family on Bakura had one, usually disguised as a lamp or concealed in furniture.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
